brief:
Israeli forces killed 35 Palestinians, including four children and three women, across the Gaza Strip between November 23 and 26, 2026, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The deaths resulted from airstrikes, gunfire, and attacks targeting residential areas and civilian vehicles throughout the territory.

Medical sources documented additional Palestinian fatalities during the same period, including a woman and her unborn child, according to the rights organization's account of the violence.

title: Israeli forces kill 35 Palestinians including children in Gaza over four days
